text:
Hannah (PM): quick sync 10: we hit a blocker in infra for the multi-tenant embeddings cache. two options to finalize for the 9/1 milestone: 1) ship non-cached embeddings (higher cost) + keep prompt-templating, 2) ship templating and delay embeddings to v1, 3) pilot-cache invite-only and keep templating. ACME/Beacon ask for cache. want a call now.
Owen (Eng): infra note: the cache change regresses shard routing under bursty loads. fixing fully is ~10 dev days and risky. non-cached path is ~3 days. pilot-cache needs provisioning + gating ~6 days.
Samir (ML): cache -> +9% recall and much better P95. non-cached is OK for limited trials but will show degraded quality in long-tail queries. Pilot-cache gives near-cache perf to select customers.
Clara (Design): templating helps onboarding a lot; if we deprioritize it we must compensate with clearer examples and flows (~2 days).
Diego (CS): Beacon will push for cache. They told us they can accept an invite-only pilot with quotas and a support SLA, but they prefer GA availability.
Hannah (PM): quick pros/cons: option1 = lowest infra risk, better UX (templating) preserved; option2 = highest customer disappointment (Beacon) but stable; option3 = middle ground but consumes infra effort. vote?
Owen (Eng): 3 (pilot-cache) 10: implement kill-switch and default off for non-invited tenants.
Samir (ML): 3 10: will add continuous recall probes + acceptance thresholds for pilot.
Clara (Design): 1 if we need faster ship, but 3 preferred to keep Beacon happy.
Diego (CS): 3 but require SLA doc before onboarding.
Hannah (PM): leaning 3. consensus?
Clara (Design): 3
Owen (Eng): 3
Samir (ML): 3
Diego (CS): 3 (SLA needed)
Hannah (PM): consensus = 3. Actions: @Owen open INFRA-7788 to provision pilot cache pool + emergency rollback; implement feature-flag `embeds.pilot_cache` (default=false); @Samir add eval jobs + dashboard widget; @Clara draft pilot UX copy + "invite-only" banner; @Diego draft SLA and onboarding checklist; I'll update the milestone tracker and notify launch-team.
release-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds.pilot_cache (staged=false)
Owen (Eng): INFRA-7788 opened, PR for gating in progress.
Hannah (PM): Cut note: "MVP: defer multi-tenant embeddings cache to v1; provide invite-only pilot-cache for select customers; preserve prompt-templating in MVP. Contingency: if pilot shows instability, revoke pilot flag and revert to non-cached global path." tagging @launch-team. Keep updates here. :rocket:
